title: Is this a joke?
text: Received this as a gift (whatever happened to the "personal" part of a gift--junk for my dog???!!!). I was shocked at the few worthless items in this little box. I'm sending it back. A toy that wouldn't last 5 minutes and a couple of little bags of treats and a silly little "fancy" collar that my dog would not enjoy wearing for a minute. The most unappreciated "gift" I have ever received.
label: negative
